Counsel for Applicant :- Shree Prakash Giri,Subhash Chandra Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Misc. Case No.334 of 2005 (Smt.Hemlata Kardam Vs. Joginder Singh and others), under Sections 498A, 323,
504 & 506 I.P.C and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Sadar Bazar District- Agra,
pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that instant dispute is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled the dispute out of the Court and have filed settlement deed.

Copy of the Joginder Singh And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155610750/
1 compromise deed dated 26.05.2023 which has been filed as Annexure 6 to the application.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the fact.

entities.text: Joginder Singh And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, it is provided that the parties shall appear before the court below along with a certified copy of this order on the next date fixed.

It is, therefore, expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
It shall be open to the applicants to file a fresh application U/S 482 at that stage for the relief sought herein.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of five weeks, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.
